name: Macon
gaps: Parcels are JustParcels Tax Parcels (CAMA + polygons) (https://gis.maconnc.org/arcgis/rest/services/JustParcels/MapServer/0). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 6332 rows; 6321 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
Pass 2 enrichment is from card pass2 (tax ok, sale ok). Pass 2 counted 338 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
